review_evidence: Parsed the 141 file paths from the brief and ran a declaration grep over each; total 3,944 line-start declaration or command matches.

HexPolyFp/PrimeField.lean (290 bytes, read completely): copyright header, `module`, `public import HexPolyFp.Degree`, `public import HexModArith.Field`, and a doc comment 'Compatibility import for prime-field polynomial consumers.' It is an import-only module; FILTER-007 keeps it primary-eligible because no auxiliary query channel for it was verified.

Lowest-count nonzero files (HexArith/Nat/ModArith.lean 1 match, HexPolyZGcd/Divide.lean, HexModArithMathlib/Ring.lean, HexRootsMathlib/Rouche.lean, HexHermite/Cert.lean, HexOrderedFnMathlib/LiouvilleRun.lean with 2 each) still carry declarations.

HexOrderedFnMathlib/LiouvilleRun.lean (first 60 lines read): defines private def secondFinite and a main that checks sign, compare and approximation behaviour of Extension over RationalFn; formal definitions over the library's ordered field extension.

HexOrderedFnMathlib/InfinitesimalTests.lean (grep output read): theorems product_identity, core_delta_lt_power, core_delta_pos, epsilon_pos, delta_lt_epsilon, reciprocal_gt_int and many examples on ordered rational function fields.

Largest files (HexHermite/Hermite.lean 92,399 bytes, HexPolyFp/SquareFree/Algebra.lean 82,885, HexBareiss/Bareiss.lean 79,887, HexPolyFp/Quotient.lean 78,464) are ordinary Lean source with many declarations; no generated data or benchmark output was found in the set.
summary: Surveyed all 141 listed .lean files (2,764,395 bytes) in reservoir-sources/kim-em__hex-dev across HexArith, HexBareiss, HexGF2Mathlib, HexHermite, HexMatrix, HexModArithMathlib, HexOrderedFnMathlib, HexPolyFp, HexPolyZGcd, HexPrimalityMathlib and HexRootsMathlib. A line-start grep for theorem/lemma/def/structure/class/instance/inductive/abbrev/example/axiom/opaque/macro/syntax/elab/#eval/#check (with private/protected/noncomputable/partial/unsafe/meta/public modifiers) found 3,944 matches; 140 of 141 files have at least one. The one zero-match file, HexPolyFp/PrimeField.lean, is a public-import compatibility module and stays primary-eligible under FILTER-007. Test-named files (Tests, InfinitesimalTests, LiouvilleTests, LiouvilleRun) hold theorems, examples and definitions over the library's ordered-field objects. Every file stays searchable; no exclusions.
